basic_details.short_information: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist–III post on a project-based engagement. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Post Graduate Degree with 5 years experience, or a Ph.D. with 2 years experience, or a 4-year Engineering/IT/Computer Science Graduate Degree with 5 years experience. content_sections.heading: IIIT-Delhi Project Research Scientist–III at a Glance

rows.details: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi)
Department of Computational Biology (Translational Biology Lab)
Development of an affordable Indigenous Integrated Platform (reagents and analysis software) for Non-Invasive Prenatal Screening (NIPS) of Fetal Aneuploidies
Initially for 11 months (subject to 3-month probation and satisfactory performance)
₹78,000/- per month + HRA as per applicable ICMR norms

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification covers a single position for the ICMR funded project at the Translational Biology Lab.

rows.reporting_to: Dr. Jaspreet Kaur Dhanjal, Assistant Professor, Department of Computational Biology, IIIT-Delhi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy any one of the essential qualification pathways specified in the notification: Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, with five years of post-qualification experience, OR Ph.D. with two years of post-qualification experience. For Engineering / IT / Computer Science: Four-year Graduate Degree with five years of post-qualification experience, OR Post Graduate Degree with three years of post-qualification experience, OR Ph.D. Desirable Skills: Strong background in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics or Data Science; experience in Python/R, statistical analysis, machine learning/deep learning, and biological or clinical data analysis; experience working with large-scale biomedical, genomic, clinical, or other healthcare-related datasets; demonstrated research experience through publications, research projects, software/tools, patents, or other relevant outputs; experience working in interdisciplinary or multi-institutional research projects involving clinicians, hospitals, or industry; strong scientific writing, communication, coordination, and project-management skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹78,000/- per month plus HRA, as admissible, as per applicable ICMR project norms. The appointment is initially for 11 months, subject to the successful completion of a three-month probation period, and may be extended based on satisfactory performance, project requirements, availability of funds, and applicable IIIT-Delhi norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT-Delhi Project Research Scientist–III
content_sections.text: Access the official application link provided by the institute. Fill out the application through the designated Google Form. Submit the completed application form on or before 21 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection committee may decide the shortlisting criteria. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email and followed up with the interview round. ICMR and IIIT-Delhi norms will be followed in hiring, and the Institute's decision will be final in all respects.
